name: D&D Miniatures Viking Longship Wood Laser Cut 1 Inch Square Grid Ship Battle Map for Dungeons and Dragons, Pathfinder or Other Tabletop RPG
description: BEAUTIFUL AND FUNCTIONAL DESIGN: Everything from the structure to the small details like the coil of rope and the powder kegs on the bottom deck is so well thought out. Especially the dragon figurehead and the tail are beautifully sculpted. This RPG ship will add an element of immersion to your tabletop game! GREAT FOR TABLETOP COMBAT: These 1" x 1" grids on the deck are clear, perfect for any battle or adventure on the rivers and seas of the tabletop RPG world. You and your players will enjoy many scenic adventures using this Viking Warship at the gaming table. MEASUREMENTS: The size of the deck is 14.7" x 4.5", that fits most medium and small miniatures. This wood Viking ship not only perfect for Dungeons and Dragons, but it makes such a great display stand for miniatures! EASY TO ASSEMBLE: No glue, no screws - This amazing tabletop ship with mortise-tenon connections for easy build up or tear down. And we have drawn highly illustrated assembly instructions for every piece to help you build them easier. UNIQUE GIFT FOR RPG PLAYER: Best for most RPG Settings, and ideas for a Viking/nordic-themed campaign. This wooden boat would be a novelty gift for DM or friends who love everything pirates and miniatures. So build a raiding fleet to pillage the coast now! The Viking Warship is ready to set sail, a ship for all your campaigns. If you are on a lake, river, or even the ocean, you need a ship to sail. It is 16.8 inches long and the upper deck is just over 4.5 inches across. The entire ship is gridded with 1x1 squares for easy play. Built from high-quality birch plywood and excellent craftsmanship. Strong enough for several miniatures including a huge-sized one if need be. Perfect for your viking themed campaign. Your DM will cant wait to incorporate this into current story!
